title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic ships the Economic Index connector — its labor-impact dataset is now callable inside Claude (Jul 22)
bullets.summary: Enable it from the claude.ai connectors directory (no install, any model) and ask which occupations use AI most or which tasks are being automated, with answers drawn directly from Anthropic's public Economic Index data.
bullets.how: A ready-made, citable data source for PRAGMA's AI-operator pitch; wire it into client diagnostics so the 'why an operator agent now' case rests on Anthropic's own numbers, not our assertions.

bullets.title: Anthropic's Microsoft 365 connector gains write tools — Claude can now draft/send email, manage calendar, and write OneDrive & SharePoint files (July)
bullets.summary: The M365 connector moves from read-only to actionable: compose and send mail, manage calendar events, change mailbox settings, and create/update files across OneDrive and SharePoint.
bullets.how: Turns M365 from a lookup surface into an execution surface for The Construct/B9S back-office ops; one Construct agent can run inbox triage, scheduling, and doc drafting end-to-end instead of handing steps back to a human.

bullets.title: MCP 2026-07-28 stateless spec is now 5 days out — the breaking rewrite ratifies next Tuesday
bullets.summary: The stateless core (no session id, any request to any instance, OAuth-aligned auth, formal deprecation policy) plus MCP Apps (server-rendered UI) and the Tasks extension land as the ratified spec on Jul 28; beta SDKs are already out.
bullets.how: Every MCP server The Construct runs is 5 days from a breaking change; close the migration inventory + hardening checklist before Tuesday. The Tasks extension maps directly onto our long-running scan jobs. Load-bearing action.

bullets.title: 'Every SaaS ships an MCP' wave keeps landing — NetHunt CRM and Pipedrive go native MCP, and Reel Estate MCP turns listing video into plain-language agent calls
bullets.summary: NetHunt and Pipedrive join HubSpot/Zoho/Close/Affinity with native read-write MCP; separately, Reel Estate MCP lets an agent generate motion clips, virtual-stage photos, add voiceover, and render finished listing videos in plain language.
bullets.how: The CRM MCPs are the PRAGMA 'replace [SaaS tool]' reference architecture, and Reel Estate is the closest analog yet to a Brand 9 Signs creative-ops MCP: a plain-language pipeline from asset to finished signage/spot one Construct agent could own.

bullets.title: arXiv — 'Harnessing Agent Skills: A Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents' (2606.20631), paired with 'Towards Secure Agent Skills' (2604.02837)
bullets.summary: Frames skills as persistent, discoverable artifacts bound to context and authority constraints at run time; the security companion defines the filesystem-based skill package plus its threat taxonomy.
bullets.how: A direct blueprint for The Construct's installed-skills registry and skills-scan: treat every skill (including demonstration-minted 'Record a Skill' outputs) as a governed, security-reviewed, authority-scoped asset rather than a loose macro.

praxis_lesson: Anthropic keeps converting read surfaces into action surfaces — the M365 connector's new write tools mean a Construct agent can now execute inbox, calendar, and document work end-to-end, so the bottleneck shifts from 'can it act' to 'is it governed to act.' The load-bearing move stays the Jul-28 stateless-MCP migration + hardening inventory (5 days out); the standing discipline is to scope every new write-capable connector and every new skill to least authority before switching it on.
